name: co-scientist-toolkit
description: Claude Code skills and hooks for research: reading papers properly, respecting their licences, working with rigour, recording and transcribing meetings, and making audio and documents, with everything possible kept on your own computer

plugins.name: papers
plugins.description: Fetch arXiv source, turn PDFs into Markdown locally, search your papers, trace each number in a paper to its source, verify references, review papers and import them into Zotero, with a hook that keeps the full text of subscription papers out of the conversation

plugins.name: meetings
plugins.description: Skills for recording and transcribing meetings on your own Mac with the meeting tool in this repository (OBS, whisper.cpp, pyannote); nothing is uploaded

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Working discipline for research: decide whether an idea is worth pursuing and pre-register predictions, check whether an iterative loop is converging, run hard problems through five gates, put decisions on a page to tick, and use Mathematica for exact and high-precision work

plugins.name: audio
plugins.description: Speech from text and papers read aloud on your own Mac with Kokoro-82M, through the pdf2audio tools; no text or audio leaves the machine

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Typeset PDFs and slide decks from Markdown, self-contained HTML documents, a course or docs site bound into one printable PDF, and narrated explainer videos made with Manim
